<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>Golden character animation</title>
<style>
html,body{margin:0;width:240px;height:294px;overflow:hidden;background:#dad8d1}
canvas{display:block;width:240px;height:294px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ preserveDrawingBuffer: true });
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240, 294, false);
renderer.setClearColor(0xdad8d1);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-2.4, 2.4, 2.94, -2.94, .1, 50);
ref.position.set(0, 0, 13);
ref.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

const backdrop = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(2, 2), new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
  depthTest: false,
  depthWrite: false,
  vertexShader: `
    void main(){gl_Position=vec4(position.xy,.99999,1.);}
  `,
  fragmentShader: `
    float hash(vec2 p){
      vec3 q=fract(vec3(p.xyx)*.1031);
      q+=dot(q,q.yzx+33.33);
      return fract((q.x+q.y)*q.z);
    }
    void main(){
      vec2 p=vec2(gl_FragCoord.x,294.-gl_FragCoord.y);
      float top=exp(-pow((p.y+9.)/69.,2.));
      float floorHaze=smoothstep(202.,302.,p.y+5.*sin(p.x*.024));
      vec2 r=(p-vec2(210.,136.))/vec2(101.,94.);
      vec2 l=(p-vec2(37.,171.))/vec2(85.,81.);
      vec3 c=vec3(.949,.945,.938)-top*vec3(.099,.092,.081)
        -floorHaze*vec3(.151,.153,.150)+exp(-dot(r,r))*vec3(.051,.056,.063)
        +exp(-dot(l,l))*vec3(.038,.043,.051);
      vec2 pixel=floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
      c+=(hash(pixel)-.5)*.053+(mod(pixel.x+pixel.y,2.)-.5)*.014;
      c+=(vec3(hash(pixel+17.),hash(pixel+83.),hash(pixel+213.))-.5)*.024;
      gl_FragColor=vec4(c,1.);
    }
  `
}));
backdrop.name = 'soft gray studio background';
backdrop.frustumCulled = false;
backdrop.renderOrder = -100;
scene.add(backdrop);

scene.add(new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfffaf1, 0xc1b2a0, 2.25));
scene.add(new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, .44));
function directional(color, intensity, x, y, z) {
  const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(color, intensity);
  light.position.set(x,y,z);
  scene.add(light);
}
directional(0xfff3d8, .93, -3, 6, 8);
directional(0xf5f2ff, .42, 5, 1, 4);
directional(0xfff0cb, .7, 1, 5, -6);

const matte = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({vertexColors:true,roughness:.94});
matte.onBeforeCompile = shader => {
  shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader.replace('#include <colorspace_fragment>', `
    #include <colorspace_fragment>
    vec2 pixel=floor(gl_FragCoord.xy);
    vec3 q=fract(vec3(pixel.xyx)*.1031);
    q+=dot(q,q.yzx+33.33);
    float grain=fract((q.x+q.y)*q.z)-.5;
    gl_FragColor.rgb+=grain*.044+(mod(pixel.x+pixel.y,2.)-.5)*.010;
  `);
};

const tau = Math.PI * 2;
const {clamp, lerp:mix, smoothstep:smooth} = THREE.MathUtils;
const front = new THREE.Vector3(0,0,1);
const vec = (x,y,z) => new THREE.Vector3(x,y,z);
const at = (x,y,z) => vec((x-120)/50,(147-y)/50,z/50);
const origins = new WeakMap([[scene,vec(0,0,0)]]);

function group(name,parent,pivot) {
  const part = new THREE.Group();
  part.name = name;
  const origin = at(...pivot);
  part.position.copy(origin).sub(origins.get(parent));
  origins.set(part,origin);
  parent.add(part);
  return part;
}

function rings(name,parent,rows,sides,pointAt,colorAt,capStart=true,capEnd=true,normalAt) {
  const positions=[],colors=[],indices=[],normals=[];
  const origin=origins.get(parent);
  for(let row=0;row<=rows;row++) {
    const u=row/rows;
    for(let side=0;side<sides;side++) {
      const angle=tau*side/sides;
      const point=pointAt(u,angle);
      const color=colorAt(u,angle,point);
      positions.push(point.x-origin.x,point.y-origin.y,point.z-origin.z);
      colors.push(color.r,color.g,color.b);
      if(normalAt) normals.push(...normalAt(u,angle).toArray());
      if(row<rows) {
        const a=row*sides+side;
        const b=row*sides+(side+1)%sides;
        indices.push(a,a+sides,b,b,a+sides,b+sides);
      }
    }
  }
  const end=rows*sides;
  for(let side=1;side<sides-1;side++) {
    if(capStart) indices.push(0,side,side+1);
    if(capEnd) indices.push(end,end+side+1,end+side);
  }
  const geo=new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geo.setAttribute('position',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions,3));
  geo.setAttribute('color',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(colors,3));
  geo.setIndex(indices);
  if(normalAt) geo.setAttribute('normal',new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(normals,3));
  else geo.computeVertexNormals();
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(geo,matte);
  mesh.name=name;
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}

const palette = stops => stops.map(([y,c])=>[y,new THREE.Color(c)]);
function colorRamp(stops,y) {
  let i=0;
  while(i<stops.length-2 && y>stops[i+1][0]) i++;
  const [a,ca]=stops[i], [b,cb]=stops[i+1];
  return ca.clone().lerp(cb,clamp((y-a)/(b-a),0,1));
}

const character=group('character-golden-figure',scene,[102,153,0]);
const torso=group('torso',character,[101,145,0]);

const profile=[
  [17.2,101.4,.18,.3,.18,.18],

  [22.5,102.1,15.1,0,12.1,12.8],

  [46,102.1,22.1,-.9,18.8,19.1],
  [56,100.5,27.5,-1.5,21.2,22.4],
  [67,98.9,33.8,-2.2,25.5,27.1],
  [80,98.1,41,-3,30.1,31.5],
  [94,97.7,45.2,-3.7,35.2,35.5],
  [107,98.7,46.7,-4,42.1,38.6],

  [140,101.2,56,-2.3,54.3,43.6],

  [174,102.8,55.1,-.2,52.7,43.8],
  [191,102.5,50.3,0,46.6,40.2],
  [207,101.5,43.4,-.8,38.5,35.3],
  [218,100,36.9,-1.3,30.2,29.4],
  [227,99.9,28,-2.6,20.5,22.3],
  [233,99.9,16.3,-3.2,11,14.1],
  [236,99.9,.2,-3.5,.2,.2]
];

function hermite(a,b,p,q,t) {
  const t2=t*t,t3=t2*t;
  return (2*t3-3*t2+1)*a+(t3-2*t2+t)*p+(-2*t3+3*t2)*b+(t3-t2)*q;
}

function section(y) {
  let i=0;
  while(i<profile.length-2 && y>profile[i+1][0]) i++;
  const a=profile[i],b=profile[i+1];
  const prev=profile[Math.max(0,i-1)],next=profile[Math.min(profile.length-1,i+2)];
  const span=b[0]-a[0],t=clamp((y-a[0])/span,0,1);
  return a.slice(1).map((_,n)=>{
    const k=n+1;
    return hermite(a[k],b[k],span*(b[k]-prev[k])/(b[0]-prev[0]),
      span*(next[k]-a[k])/(next[0]-a[0]),t);
  });
}

function bodyPoint(y,angle) {
  const [center,radius,depthCenter,near,far]=section(y);
  const facing=Math.cos(angle),x=center+radius*Math.sin(angle);
  const nose=1.65*Math.exp(-Math.pow((x-103.3)/5,2)-Math.pow((y-41.8)/5.3,2));
  const muzzle=.65*Math.exp(-Math.pow((x-103)/10.2,2)-Math.pow((y-49.1)/4.9,2));
  return at(x,y,depthCenter+facing*(facing>=0?near:far)+Math.max(0,facing)*(nose+muzzle));
}

const skin=palette([
  [17,0xd3c05e],[35,0xceba58],[49,0xc8ac51],[68,0xd7b756],[88,0xe4c769],
  [111,0xe3c063],[140,0xe0ba61],[170,0xd8ad55],[197,0xd0a04a],[218,0xc49848],[236,0xad7e37]
]);
const belly=palette([
  [88,0xece1b1],[108,0xebe0b8],[129,0xe6d8ac],[148,0xe2cea0],[164,0xdfc48c],
  [180,0xdab874],[196,0xd5ac5c],[214,0xcba04b]
]);
function bodyColor(y,angle,point) {
  const x=120+point.x*50, facing=Math.cos(angle), dx=x-103;
  const edge=91.2+41*Math.pow(Math.abs(dx)/55,2)-1.55*Math.sin(dx*.13)+.045*dx;
  const bib=smooth(y,edge-3.8,edge+6.5)*smooth(facing,.035,.53)*(1-smooth(y,175,220));
  const mouthShade=facing>0?Math.exp(-Math.pow(dx/15,2)-Math.pow((y-54.5)/7.3,2))*.085:0;
  const browShade=facing>0?Math.exp(-Math.pow((Math.abs(dx)-11)/6.2,2)-Math.pow((y-37.8)/5,2))*.072:0;
  const flecks=Math.sin(x*.19+y*.095)*Math.sin(y*.29-angle*2);
  return colorRamp(skin,y).lerp(colorRamp(belly,y),bib).multiplyScalar(1-mouthShade-browShade+.019*flecks);
}

function bodyPiece(name,parent,start,end,capStart,capEnd) {
  const yAt=u=>mix(start,end,u);
  rings(name,parent,Math.ceil((end-start)*.86),104,
    (u,a)=>bodyPoint(yAt(u),a),(u,a,p)=>bodyColor(yAt(u),a,p),capStart,capEnd,
    (u,a)=>{
      const y=yAt(u);
      const along=bodyPoint(Math.min(236,y+.05),a).sub(bodyPoint(Math.max(17.2,y-.05),a));
      const around=bodyPoint(y,a+.001).sub(bodyPoint(y,a-.001));
      return along.cross(around).normalize();
    });
}
bodyPiece('continuous neck and torso',torso,63,236,false,true);
bodyPiece('rounded head',head,17.2,63,true,false);

function tubeSampler(knots,rows,points) {
  const curve=new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points||knots.map(p=>at(p[0],p[1],p[2])));
  const samples=[];
  for(let i=0;i<=rows;i++) {
    const u=i/rows;
    const tangent=curve.getTangent(u).normalize();
    const across=front.clone().cross(tangent);
    if(across.lengthSq()<1e-8) across.set(1,0,0);
    across.normalize();
    const depth=tangent.clone().cross(across).normalize();
    const k=Math.min(knots.length-2,Math.floor(u*(knots.length-1)));
    const weight=u*(knots.length-1)-k;
    samples.push([
      curve.getPoint(u),
      across.multiplyScalar(mix(knots[k][3],knots[k+1][3],weight)/50),
      depth.multiplyScalar(mix(knots[k][4],knots[k+1][4],weight)/50)
    ]);
  }
  return (u,angle)=>{
    const [center,across,depth]=samples[Math.round(u*rows)];
    return center.clone().addScaledVector(across,Math.sin(angle)).addScaledVector(depth,Math.cos(angle));
  };
}

function tube(name,parent,knots,pigment,sides=16) {
  const rows=Math.max(16,(knots.length-1)*7);
  return rings(name,parent,rows,sides,tubeSampler(knots,rows),
    (u,angle,p)=>pigment(147-p.y*50,angle,u));
}

]);

const legRight=group('leg-right',character,[123,211,-1]);

],legTint(1),40);

  [125,198,-3,8,10],[122,215,-2,20,27],[120,232,-1,19.2,23],[117,254,-1,17,20],
  [115,276,-1,13.5,16],[114,294,-2,10.7,12],[114,308,-2,9,9],[114,315,-1,2,2.5]
],legTint(-1),40);

const sphere=new THREE.SphereGeometry(1,32,24);
function oval(name,parent,color,x,y,z,sx,sy,sz,roughness=.94) {
  const mesh=new THREE.Mesh(sphere,new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({color,roughness}));
  mesh.name=name;
  mesh.position.set(x,y,z);
  mesh.scale.set(sx,sy,sz);
  parent.add(mesh);
  return mesh;
}
function foot(parent,name,x,z,direction) {
  const joint=group(name,parent,[x,309,z]);
  const mesh=oval('rounded foot',joint,0xaa8043,direction*.035,-.075,.15,.225,.12,.355);
  mesh.rotation.y=direction*.17;
}
foot(legLeft,'foot-left',88,-2,-1);
foot(legRight,'foot-right',114,-2,1);

const armColors=palette([
  [83,0xdac16b],[114,0xd9bc64],[138,0xd2b362],[156,0xc2a259],
  [167,0xaa8f4f],[177,0x887342],[187,0x5b5035],[198,0x47412f]

const handColors=palette([
  [183,0x73603d],[190,0x574c35],[202,0x474334],[221,0x494438]

const handTint=(y,a)=>colorRamp(handColors,y).multiplyScalar(.94+.08*Math.cos(a));

function makeArm(side,shoulder,wrist,tip,knots,palm,fingers) {
  const arm=group('arm-'+side,character,shoulder);
  const sleeve=tube('shoulder and forearm',arm,knots,y=>colorRamp(armColors,y-(side==='right'?3:0)),28);
  sleeve.frustumCulled=false;
  const hand=group('hand-'+side,arm,wrist);
  tube('palm',hand,palm,handTint,24);
  const digits=fingers.map(([name,thickness,...joints])=>{
    const part=group(name,hand,joints[0]);
    tube('finger skin',part,joints.map(([x,y,z],i)=>{
      const radius=thickness*[1,.84,.65,.13][i];
      return [x,y,z,radius,radius*.82];
    }),handTint,12);
    return part;
  });
  const restWrist=at(...wrist);
  return {
    arm,sleeve,hand,knots,digits,restWrist,restElbow:at(...knots[4]),
    restTip:at(...tip),restPoints:knots.map(p=>at(p[0],p[1],p[2])),
    rows:(knots.length-1)*7
  };
}

function faceDepth(x,y) {
  const [center,radius]=section(y);
  return bodyPoint(y,Math.asin(clamp((x-center)/radius,-.995,.995))).z*50;
}
function faceLine(name,parent,coords,hex) {
  const color=new THREE.Color(hex);
  tube(name,parent,coords.map(([x,y,o,r,d])=>[x,y,faceDepth(x,y)+o,r,d]),()=>color,12);
}

function openEye(parent,x,y,side) {
  const lid=group('open eye',parent,[x,y,faceDepth(x,y)]);
  lid.rotation.y=.66*side;
  lid.rotation.x=-.12;
  oval('golden olive eye surround',lid,0xb9b650,0,.006,-.018,.154,.154,.079);
  oval('green iris',lid,0x6b9960,.008,0,.019,.110,.117,.058,.59);
  oval('dark pupil',lid,0x071817,.014,-.002,.059,.074,.080,.031,.43);
  oval('small catchlight',lid,0x6c8877,-.008,.032,.085,.014,.012,.007,.46);
  return lid;
}

// The body track gives crown position, scale, turn, lean, pitch, eyes, smile and hip angles.

const still=[

const poses=[

function tangent(p,q) {
  return p*q>0 ? 2*p*q/(p+q) : 0;
}

function samplePose(time) {
  let index=0;
  while(index<poses.length-2 && time>poses[index+1][0]) index++;
  const a=poses[index],b=poses[index+1];
  const prev=poses[Math.max(0,index-1)],next=poses[Math.min(poses.length-1,index+2)];
  const span=b[0]-a[0],u=(time-a[0])/span;
  return [1,2,3].map(track=>a[track].map((start,k)=>{
    const end=b[track][k], slope=(end-start)/span;
    const enter=prev===a?0:tangent((start-prev[track][k])/(a[0]-prev[0]),slope);
    const exit=next===b?0:tangent(slope,(next[track][k]-end)/(next[0]-b[0]));
    return hermite(start,end,enter*span,exit*span,u);
  }));
}

const rootOrigin=origins.get(character);
const crown=at(101.4,17.2,.48).sub(rootOrigin);
const inverseRoot=new THREE.Matrix4();
const elbowWeights=[0,0,.29,.62,1,.56,.15,0];
const wristWeights=[0,0,0,0,0,.44,.85,1];

function screenInBind(x,y,z) {
  return at(x,y,z).applyMatrix4(inverseRoot).add(rootOrigin);
}

function handFrame(direction,normal,roll) {
  const y=direction.clone().normalize();
  const x=y.clone().cross(normal).normalize();
  const z=x.clone().cross(y);
  x.applyAxisAngle(y,roll);
  z.applyAxisAngle(y,roll);
  return new THREE.Quaternion().setFromRotationMatrix(new THREE.Matrix4().makeBasis(x,y,z));
}

function poseArm(part,pose,turn) {
  const [ex,ey,ez,wx,wy,wz,tx,ty,tz,roll,curl,splay]=pose;
  const elbow=screenInBind(ex,ey,ez);
  const wrist=screenInBind(wx,wy,wz);
  const tip=screenInBind(tx,ty,tz);
  const elbowDelta=elbow.sub(part.restElbow);
  const wristDelta=wrist.clone().sub(part.restWrist);
  const points=part.restPoints.map((point,i)=>
    point.clone().addScaledVector(elbowDelta,elbowWeights[i]).addScaledVector(wristDelta,wristWeights[i]));
  const sample=tubeSampler(part.knots,part.rows,points);
  const origin=origins.get(part.arm);
  const attribute=part.sleeve.geometry.getAttribute('position');
  for(let row=0;row<=part.rows;row++) {
    for(let side=0;side<28;side++) {
      const point=sample(row/part.rows,tau*side/28).sub(origin);
      attribute.setXYZ(row*28+side,point.x,point.y,point.z);
    }
  }
  attribute.needsUpdate=true;
  part.sleeve.geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  part.sleeve.geometry.computeBoundingSphere();
  part.sleeve.geometry.computeBoundingBox();

  part.hand.position.copy(wrist).sub(origin);
  const palmNormal=vec(Math.sin(-turn*.75),0,Math.cos(turn*.75));
  const base=handFrame(part.restTip.clone().sub(part.restWrist),front,0);
  part.hand.quaternion.copy(handFrame(tip.sub(wrist),palmNormal,roll)).multiply(base.invert());
  const spread=part===left?[-.85,-.44,.05,.46,.91]:[.85,.44,-.05,-.46,-.91];
  part.digits.forEach((digit,i)=>{
    digit.rotation.set(-curl*(i===0?.55:1+(i-2)*.09),0,splay*spread[i]);
  });
}

function render(t) {
  const period=5540;
  const time=((t%period)+period)%period;
  const [body,leftPose,rightPose]=samplePose(time);
  const [x,y,sx,sy,sz,turn,lean,pitch,opening,smile,leftHip,rightHip]=body;
  character.scale.set(sx,sy,sz);
  character.rotation.set(pitch,turn,lean,'ZYX');
  character.position.copy(at(x,y,.48)).sub(crown.clone().multiply(character.scale).applyQuaternion(character.quaternion));
  character.updateMatrixWorld(true);
  inverseRoot.copy(character.matrixWorld).invert();

  legLeft.rotation.set(leftHip,0,-lean*.29-leftHip*.22);
  legRight.rotation.set(rightHip,0,-lean*.29+rightHip*.20);
  poseArm(left,leftPose,turn);
  poseArm(right,rightPose,turn);

  for(const eye of [openLeft,openRight]) {
    eye.visible=opening>.12;
    eye.scale.y=Math.max(.07,opening);
  }
  closedLeft.visible=closedRight.visible=opening<=.12;
  mouth.scale.y=Math.abs(smile)<.12?(smile<0?-.12:.12):smile;
  mouth.scale.x=1+Math.max(0,smile-1)*.09;
  renderer.render(scene,ref);
}

render(0);
window.nwb={scene,renderer,cameras:{ref},characters:[character],render,ready:true};
